messages:
marta-ng: Heads-up: planning a staged rollout of model-serving v2.1 to prod tonight at 02:00 UTC. Scope: routing change + kv-cache tweak + small quantization tweak. Need owners for deploy, on-watch, and quick obs tweaks (dash panels + alert thresholds).

kevin-cho: I can run the deploy. ETA 02:00 UTC start, ~30m window for canary -> ramp -> full.

liz-ops: I can take on-watch for the first 60m after full ramp. Will monitor latency, error rate, and trace waterfalls.

sanjay-ml: I'll validate output quality and monitor token-generation regressions. Can run a subset of eval prompts during canary.

marta-ng: thanks. Quick list of observability tasks I want done before we go:
- add transient panel showing canary vs baseline p50/p95/p99 for token latency
- set temporary alert threshold for 5xx rate > 0.5% over 5m on canary hosts
- increase trace-sampling for model infra to 20% during the window
- add KV cache hit-rate panel and a small low-threshold alert (< 80%)

kevin-cho: noted. Can we get the exact metric queries so I can paste in the dashboard during deploy?

devex-bot: snippet suggestion: PromQL for p95 token latency (histogram buckets):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, job))
```
Use label job="model-serving" and deploy_tag for canary.

devex-bot: KV cache hit-rate (counter delta):
```
100 * (rate(kv_cache_hits[5m]) / (rate(kv_cache_hits[5m]) + rate(kv_cache_misses[5m])))
```

liz-ops: For Datadog monitor quick rule: APM error rate: 
- query: avg(last_5m):sum:trace.errors{service:model-serving,env:prod,deploy:canary} / sum:trace.requests{service:model-serving,env:prod,deploy:canary} > 0.005
- notify: @eng-oncall @kevin-cho @liz-ops

marta-ng: perfect. For smoke tests, use these commands (canary host DNS will be prefixed with canary-):
```
# quick generation smoke
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://canary-model-serving.internal/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-v2", "prompt":"Summarize: The quick brown fox...","max_tokens":32}' | jq .
# small embedding check
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://canary-model-serving.internal/api/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embed-lite","input":"test"}' | jq .
```

kevin-cho: I'll run smoke within the canary stage and paste outputs in this thread. If any 5xx or spike in p99 > 2x baseline, we're rolling back.

marta-ng: Rollback plan:
- Reverse routing via router-api tag switch (1m rollback cutover)
- Revert autoscaler config if we hit sustained error rates
- Postmortem stub created in /incidents if we need it

kevin-cho: A note on rollout cadence: canary for 10% of capacity for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then full. We will pause at each step and run the smoke checklist.

sanjay-ml: I'll run quality evals during 10% and 50% steps; will post summary metrics (BLEU-ish / similarity) within 5m of each step.

liz-ops: I'll watch traces and tail application logs. If I see slow tail latencies (p95 > 400ms) or error rate > 0.5% will call rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by kevin-cho at 2025-05-18T02:00:00Z, canary=10%, ramp policy=manual.

kevin-cho: starting canary now (kicking off router tag, deploying 3 canary replicas). Smoke runs in progress. Posting outputs in ~2m.

kevin-cho: smoke output: generation OK, embedding OK, no 5xx in canary logs. p95 token latency ~120ms (baseline ~110ms) — within expectations.

devex-bot: reminder: temporarily increase trace retention sampling to 20% for service=model-serving during 02:00-04:00 UTC window. Revert after 04:30.

liz-ops: seeing slight increase in KV cache misses on two hosts (hit-rate dropped to 78%). Opening a quick sticky to watch. If it drops below 75% will abort.

sanjay-ml: eval digest after 10%: quality delta <0.3% on our test set, no hallucination spikes.

kevin-cho: moving to 50% now. Pausing for 10m monitoring window.

[10m pass]
kevin-cho: 50% window passed. p99 slightly up (baseline 350ms -> 420ms) but error rates stable. Liz, do you want to proceed?

liz-ops: p99 trend is acceptable but keep an eye on the hosts with lower cache hit rates; I'm OK to proceed to full if KV hit-rate recovers above 82% in next 5m.

kevin-cho: KV hit-rate back to 83% on all canary hosts. Proceeding to full ramp.

deploy-bot: ramp to full started by kevin-cho at 2025-05-18T02:28:40Z.

kevin-cho: full rollout complete. Post-deploy smoke: generation OK, embedding OK, traces show no new errors.

liz-ops: monitoring for 30m post-ramp. No alerts firing. Keeping the temporary thresholds for 1h total then we'll revert.

marta-ng: thanks team. Follow-ups: please add the exact queries we used to the Runbook under /playbooks/deploys/model-serving-v2.1 and drop a short post in #deploys-log with the rollout times and any anomalies.

sanjay-ml: will upload eval summary in 15m.

kevin-cho: leaving a short note in the release ticket about the KV cache blip and the threshold we used.

marta-ng: closing the loop: no rollback needed, canary checks passed. Thx everyone :tada:
